metrics.label: Changes shipped by agents
metrics.jql: project = TJD AND labels = devlead AND status = Done

metrics.label: Passed an independent QA review
metrics.definition: Agent-built tickets a separate QA agent run passed (reached Ready for Merge)
metrics.jql: project = TJD AND labels = devlead AND status WAS "Ready for Merge"

metrics.label: Human approved
metrics.definition: Agent-built tickets carrying RP's rp-approved label
metrics.jql: project = TJD AND labels = devlead AND labels = rp-approved

last_change.jql: project = TJD AND labels = devlead AND status = Done ORDER BY updated DESC
